content:
The test image shows a soybean leaf with numerous small, scattered lesions featuring reddish-purple centers and distinct yellow/chlorotic halos distributed across the upper leaf surface.

**Key visual features:**
- Small circular lesions (1-5mm diameter range)
- Dark reddish/purple centers
- Clear yellow-green halos surrounding each lesion
- Uniformly scattered across the leaf upper surface
- Leaf otherwise appears green and healthy

**Comparison with Frogeye reference:** The frogeye reference confirms circular spots with dark/brown-grayish centers and reddish-brown borders, with yellow halos possible. The test image matches early-stage Frogeye leaf spot — the spots are circular, have reddish-purple centers with yellow chlorotic halos, consistent with the description: *"small, dark, water-soaked circular to angular lesions that expand into brown to grayish spots with brown-reddish borders. A yellow halo may be present around leaf spots."*

This rules out Septoria brown spot (which is more angular, red-brown, starts from lower canopy) and Soybean rust (pustules typically on undersides).
